about_the_game:
Connect your towns and dungeons with a detailed world map with the KR Brand New Overworld Tileset! Kokoro Reflections zoomed out their focus and created a bunch of gorgeous MV/MZ-sized fantasy tiles to help you make interesting maps for your players to enjoy as they explore your game’s world.

A1, A2, A4, and 5 B sheets offer up a variety of villages and cities to populate your maps, as well as a bunch of colorful doorways and crystal entrances to give your heroes all the dungeons they could want to explore! If you’ve been wanting to give your world map an upgrade, then pick up the KR Brand New Overworld Tileset!



Brand New Overworld Tileset Includes:

* water
* poison water
* lava
* whirlpools (water and lava)
* cloud layers
* lots of ground textures
* trees
* hills
* rocks
* mountains
* walls in six ground textures to match all environments
* towns
* cities
* castles
* floating hills
* huge mushrooms
* temples and unusual monuments
* huge animal tracks
* small and large doors
* bridges
* giant trees
* giant pits
* giant cities
* Stonehenge
* pyramid
* lighthouse
* wrecked ships
* and more!


Terms of Use:

* This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
* OK to be used in Commercial projects
* Contents can be edited
* OK for use in games with gore
* OK for use in adult-rated games
